Interface FlightBoardController

All Superinterfaces:
GuiController
All Known Implementing Classes:
FlightBoardControllerL1, FlightBoardControllerL2
public interface FlightBoardController extends GuiController
This interface defines the methods that the FlightBoardController must implement in order to notify the view about changes in the flight board phase of the game.
